name: Kai
self_text: I am a Polish man in my mid 20s. I first got into photography years ago and have since stuck with Nikon. When I am not taking photos, I spend my time growing chillies, as I love the challenge of cultivating something spicy from seed. For me, the joy of photography is capturing a moment in time. A typical session for me would be a relaxed photo walk at a moderate pace, where we focus on taking portraits of each other. I am available for this on Saturday afternoon, Sunday afternoon, or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available on Saturday afternoon, Sunday afternoon, or weekday evenings. You have to be into a relaxed photo walk, and it's a deal-breaker unless you are okay with a moderate pace. It would be nice if you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, but no big deal.
